access.zh: API（Gemini API / Vertex）与 Gemini 应用订阅；权重不开源（开放权重的是另一条 Gemma 线）。
access.en: API (Gemini API / Vertex) and the Gemini app subscription; weights are not open (the open-weight line is Gemma).

currentGen.zh: Gemini 3 系（最新 3.8 Flash；3.1 Pro / 3.7 / 3.6 / 3.5 Flash 在册）
currentGen.en: Gemini 3 line (latest 3.8 Flash; 3.1 Pro / 3.7 / 3.6 / 3.5 Flash listed)

generations.zh: 当前代：官方模型总览页现役 gemini-3.8-flash（模型页 1,048,576 输入 / 65,536 输出、Preview 标注）；3.8 Flash 指南链接已从 3 系指南页挂出。指南页仍注明「所有 Gemini 3 模型目前均为预览版」。Google Cloud 模型版本页标注 gemini-3.8-flash 发布日期 2026-09-02（GA）。
generations.en: Current line: the official models overview lists gemini-3.8-flash (model page: 1,048,576 input / 65,536 output, Preview label); the 3.8 Flash guide is linked from the Gemini 3 guide page. The guide still notes all Gemini 3 models are currently in preview. The Google Cloud model-versions page lists gemini-3.8-flash release date 2026-09-02 (GA).

generations.zh: 上一代（2.5 Pro/Flash 等），官方文档仍在册。
generations.en: Previous line (2.5 Pro/Flash etc.), still listed in official docs.

v.zh: 3.8 Flash：1,048,576 输入 / 65,536 输出（官方模型页）；3/3.1 代指南表口径 1M 输入 / 64K 输出
v.en: 3.8 Flash: 1,048,576 input / 65,536 output (official model page); the 3/3.1 guide-table figure is 1M input / 64K output

v.zh: 3/3.1 代 2025-01（官方指南表列）；3.8 Flash 模型页未标知识截点——本站按未知处理
v.en: 3/3.1 line: Jan 2025 (official guide table); the 3.8 Flash model page lists no knowledge cutoff — this site records it as unknown

v.zh: 官方指南注明「所有 Gemini 3 模型目前均为预览版」（2026-10-30 快照，原文 All Gemini 3 models are currently in preview）
v.en: The official guide states "All Gemini 3 models are currently in preview" (2026-10-30 snapshot)

v.zh: 文本 / 图像 / 视频 / 音频多模态（官方指南与云博客同口径）
v.en: Multimodal text / image / video / audio (official guide and cloud blog agree)

positioning.zh: Google 的闭源旗舰线；与开放权重的 Gemma 是两条线，别混。选型注意官方「预览版」标注——预览意味着规格与价格都可能变，本站只抄快照。
positioning.en: Google's closed flagship line; distinct from the open-weight Gemma line — do not conflate them. Note the official "preview" labels: preview means specs and prices may change; this site only snapshots.

onSite.zh: 开放权重侧本站收录 Gemma 4（谱系卡 + 量化对比）；Gemini 系不开权重。
onSite.en: On the open-weight side this site covers Gemma 4 (family card + quantisation); the Gemini line ships no weights.
